problems: Extended Data Fig. 4b/f/j supports the reported counts under its own headings, but the proposal treats those headings as a resolved treatment key for every group. Among the same 95 libraries, BioSample assigns Lani to all 24 displayed Gr2 libraries and GLP1:GIP:Lani to all 24 displayed Gr4 libraries, exactly the reverse of the workbook. For example, EDF4b AC4 is 25L001141 (SAMN53543136, Gr2) and L4 is 25L001163 (SAMN53543158, Gr4). All 24 Gr3 and 23 vehicle labels agree. The corrected proposal confines the treatment conclusion to the registered arms.

The GEO GSM characteristics omit sex and give coded treatments, but their linked NCBI BioSample records supply both fields. All six retained Gr3 records explicitly say GLP1:GIP and all eight controls say Vhcl. All 14 are adult male C57BL/6J hypothalamus samples. The same records do not give dosing duration, so the seven-day GEO and 12-day peripheral publication descriptions still require reconciliation for any future RNA comparison.
